cuts.label: scout:stableronaldo/stableronaldo-asks-panic-2026w33
cuts.title: Stableronaldo demands a replay, then the replay catches him
cuts.retelling: Stableronaldo demands a replay to catch other runners false-starting, but the replay shows he false-started himself, and later in the event he is declared out and blames his teammate Ray for selling him out.

cuts.label: moistcr1tikal@momentplacidcourageouswafflebcouch-g_ksoofjpqc2owtr/moistcr1tikal-design-down-2026w38
cuts.title: Moistcr1tikal let Wolverine drive himself
cuts.hook: Can this Wolverine chase even be failed?
cuts.retelling: Streamer Moistcr1tikal lets the game steer a Wolverine motorcycle chase while he answers a text, comes back to find it went fine, then tests whether he can fail it by pressing nothing, and the chase finishes on its own.

cuts.label: kaicenat@momentcreativeflirtydunlinm4xheh-qmubymsa6rvij7jd/kaicenat-about-cenat-2026w29
cuts.title: Kai Cenat cuts Ron, then apologizes to everyone else
cuts.hook: Is Dean Kai really this strict?
cuts.retelling: Playing the dean at a fake university, Kai Cenat coldly cuts a student named Ron who begs for another chance, then turns around and gushes apologies at a student who walks in soaked by the rain.

cuts.label: caseoh@vod2892274623/caseoh-caseoh-grief-2026w41
cuts.title: CaseOh thought 'grief verified' was just another meme
cuts.hook: CaseOh: 'I thought it was another meme'
cuts.retelling: CaseOh dismissed 'grief verified' as another meme, then later in the stream says he finally understands it and that it took him two years.

cuts.label: caseoh@momentendearinggentlesheepvotenay-j8vrygwgn4-ee373/caseoh-about-caseoh-2026w41
cuts.title: CaseOh has no idea what 'doggy grief verified' means
cuts.retelling: Chat keeps spamming 'doggy grief verified' at CaseOh, he has no idea what it means, snaps at them, then shrugs that he knows nothing about Geometry Dash.

cuts.label: forsen@momentoutstandingunsightlyneanderthalthetarfu-mh8pq0hvjeyadyuh/forsen-ends-enemy-2026w37
cuts.title: Forsen snipes him and he just won't die
cuts.retelling: Forsen tells his squad to kill an enemy, then snipes someone from a tower, can't believe they're still alive, and gets taken out by a helicopter.

cuts.label: xqc@momentsaltybettercrocodileampenergycherry-hk5rxhmhi8_dozzo/xqc-about-invad-2026w37
cuts.title: xQc finds out he's on the front page for robbing an ATM
cuts.hook: xQc told he's on the front page
cuts.retelling: In a game, xQc is told he's on the front page of the Live Invader magazine for robbing an ATM, and he stops the car to read it. He's told 'they got you, brother' and then looks for the page, but we never see what it says.

cuts.label: pokimane@vod2874504112/pokimane-about-camera-2026w38
cuts.title: 'All he said was hello' - Pokimane vs. a banned chatter
cuts.retelling: Pokimane insists a chatter only ever said hello in her chat, then finds out he was banned in QTCinderella's channel nine months ago and that someone denied his unban request.

cuts.label: xqc@momentapatheticenjoyableponyrickroll-asqdbrptwall5ty5/xqc-about-charact-2026w38
cuts.title: xQc has four strains of disease and a fundraiser
cuts.hook: xQc has four strains of disease
cuts.retelling: In a GTA roleplay hospital, xQc learns he has four named strains of disease, grumbles that he had to pay to be fixed, and the group offers to crowdfund for him.

cuts.label: scout:kaicenat/kaicenat-call-cenat-2026w41
cuts.title: Kai Cenat tells Reggie 'I'm done being nice'. Here's how it started.
cuts.hook: Kai is done being nice to Reggie
cuts.retelling: Kai Cenat, feuding with someone named Reggie, says he's done being nice, and the clips show him pointing to a 2:32 AM text and call log and demanding that Reggie show his proof.
